content:
hema: Heads-up: starting qz2b-int4 onboarding tomorrow. want a curated promptset that exercises tokenizer variants + mixed-locale edgecases.
uli: +1. We should avoid reusing the large holdout; make a micro-golden ~600 items and a review pool ~1400.
rafa: recommend semantic_dedupe=0.80 for embeddings from tok-v2, exact_token_overlap=0.92. token-variant checklist: byte-pair vs unigram differences.
olga: add tests for split-token boundaries (e.g. emoji + zh) — those triggered tokenization mismatch in qx runs.
labelops-bot: LabelOps capacity: 1.2k/day if we run 2 reviewers per item. Reserve slots?
hema: reserve. workflow: sample -> dedupe -> triage -> flag synthetics -> golden double-label -> final adjudication. target: start 08:00 UTC, 48h sprint.
uli: propose adversarial subset: 200 items with malformed markdown, nested JSON, and mixed codeblocks. tag='tok-adv'.
rafa: also include 75 long messages (len>2000 chars) to stress segmentation and kv cache for long-context quant path.
ops-bot: FYI: quota check — GPU test pool has 6 free slots tomorrow 08:00-12:00 UTC.
hema: good. sampling config (quick):
```
sample_mode: focused_longtail
locales: ["vi","tr","pt_BR","zh-HK","en-GB"]
semantic_embed_model: tok-v2-embed
semantic_dedupe: 0.80
exact_dedupe: 0.92
min_len_chars: 40
max_len_chars: 12000
adversarial_quota: 200
golden_count: 600
labelpool_count: 1400
exclude_lists: ["holdout_2025_main","seed_canary_qz2"]
```
olga: is tok-v2 ready for production embedding queries? last time we saw small embed drift. we may need to normalize whitespace before embed.
rafa: good catch — we'll run normalization pipeline: lower+nfkc+strip_extra_ws. quick command: `python -m curation.normalize --in s3://curation/raw --out s3://curation/normalized --nfkc`
labelops-bot: Golden review policy: double-review, adjudicate by senior if >=20% disagreement. Escalate to hema if >30%.
uli: dedupe approach: run exact first, then semantic. keep canonical sample per cluster by highest doc frequency. avoid dropping different prompt intents.
hema: can someone set up a smoke harness to run percent-critical (crit-rate) + exact-match + tokenizer-delta metric side-by-side vs qz2b-fp16 and qz2b-int8? need plots per-locale.
rafa: I'll push a lightweight job. command snippet:
```
./eval/harness.sh --models qz2b-fp16,qz2b-int8,qz2b-int4 --dataset s3://curation/qz2b/micro-golden.json --metrics crit_rate,exact_match,tokenizer_delta --output /tmp/qz2b-smoke
```
ops-bot: Canary window scheduled by deploy-bot: 2025-04-02T09:00:00Z -> qz2b-int4 on staging-pool. Notifying #eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Canary created: id=canary-qz2b-042. Targets: staging-pool-6.
olga: please also log tokenizer variants with token-level diffs, not just token counts. small diffs matter.
labelops-bot: Slots confirmed. Start time set to 2025-04-02T08:00:00Z UTC.
hema: final checklist: normalized sample uploaded, dedupe lists created, adversarial seeds flagged, labeling reserved, harness job queued, canary scheduled. If no objections we'll go tomorrow. :rocket:
uli: lgtm. I'll monitor dashboards and open a dashboard link once harness finishes.
rafa: posting initial smoke results in this thread within 14h after canary.
